description.short: Joins your Teams meetings, answers questions aloud and writes the recap.
description.full: An AI meeting assistant for staff. Mention it in a meeting chat and type join, or paste a meeting link in a personal chat, and it joins the call. It follows the meeting through live captions, answers when someone says its name, answers questions in chat, and posts a recap with decisions, actions and who explained what when the meeting ends. Afterwards, attendees can ask it about the meeting in a personal chat. It keeps transcripts for a limited period set by your administrator and does not record audio or video. Answers are written by AI and should be checked before relying on them.
